hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each batch entry against the same un-decremented available_quantity, so entries sharing (inventory_item, location) are never summed. A single cart with two lines on the shared WIDGET item (OVS-PIECE x6 needs 6 units, OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 6 units, total 12 against 10 stocked) should pass the per-entry check during complete-cart's reserve batch and be placed as an order, so the order needs more units than were stocked (no_oversell fails, and reserved_quantity may exceed stock). Expect the complete call to return an order.
